# camundacluster_role_member_client (Resource)

Assigns a client to a Camunda cluster role

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "camundacluster_role" "deployer" {
  role_id = "deployer"
  name    = "Deployer"
}

resource "camundacluster_role_member_client" "ci" {
  role_id   = camundacluster_role.deployer.id
  client_id = "ci-pipeline"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `client_id` (String) The ID of the client.
- `role_id` (String) The ID of the role.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite ID of the assignment (`role_id/client_id`). Also used as the import ID: `terraform import camundacluster_role_member_client.example <role_id>/<client_id>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import camundacluster_role_member_client.ci deployer/ci-pipeline
```
